name: Metric states and intermediates are right
purpose: A metric's state matches what its fields say, a reading is recorded once, and an intermediate metric is added once, only when the check agrees it tracks the parent's done test.
record: The share of the unit-test cases (hubofhubs/the_intelligence/critical_thinking/metric_upkeep/tests) whose actions equal what is expected: the four states, a read recorded, an intermediate added after agreement, refused on disagreement, reused on repeat.
disadvantages: The cases are written and generic; whether an intermediate metric helps a real milestone is measured by the consumer's progress cases.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=a change to the arm]
